summary.en: Sudanese army secured Bakori and Sali, repelled attacks in the Blue Nile and advanced in West Kordofan. Pakistan signed a 1.5 billion military deal to bolster Sudan’s security. The UN found Colombian mercenaries backed by the UAE fighting in Sudan. A former interior minister from the al-Bashir regime was arrested and Ahmed Haroun appeared on a podcast, prompting legal commentary. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Den sudanske hæren sikret Bakori og Sali, avviste angrep i Blå Nilen og rykket frem i Vest Kordofan. Pakistan signerte en 1.5 billion militæravtale for å styrke Sudans sikkerhet. FN fant colombianske leiesoldater støttet av De forente arabiske emirater som kjempet i Sudan. En tidligere innenriksminister fra al-Bashir-regimet ble arrestert og Ahmed Haroun dukket opp i en podkast, noe som førte til juridisk kommentar. 4,680 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Sudanese civil war (2023–present)
background.extract: Since April 2023, there has been a civil war in Sudan between the two main factions of the country's military government. The conflict involves the internationally recognized government of Sudan led by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), under General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan; against the rival Government of Peace and Unity led by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) paramilitary group, commanded by General Hemedti. Smaller armed groups have also taken part on both sides, most notably Sudan Liberation Movement splinter groups, the Tamazuj militia, and the Darfur Joint Protection Force.
background.extractNb: Konflikten i Sudan 2023 er en pågående væpnet konflikt mellom rivaliserende fraksjoner i Sudans regjering som brøt ut den 15. april 2023 over hele landet. Konflikten er hovedsakelig i hovedstaden Khartoum og i Darfurregionen.
